tickerText: [TENNIS] Jannik Sinner underwent minor iliotibial-band surgery on November 24 after months off since Wimbledon; ATP Year-End No. 1 Alexander Zverev closed the season in Turin while Carlos Alcaraz lifted his first Nitto ATP Finals trophy and tightened the gap on No. 2 Sinner in the rankings • [SQUASH] Mostafa Asal captured his 31st PSA title at the China Open in Shanghai, while Sivasangari Subramaniam was crowned after Satomi Watanabe withdrew ill from the women's final • [BADMINTON] Kunlavut Vitidsarn reclaimed BWF men's singles world No. 1 on November 24 as Syed Modi India International Super 300 round-of-32 play continued in Lucknow ahead of December's Hangzhou Finals • [PICKLEBALL] The Opendoor Pickleball World Championships set PPA/MLP single-event records with 70,000 fans, $2 million in ticket revenue and 79 million Pickleballtv minutes watched at Brookhaven Country Club in Texas • [TABLE TENNIS] Shunsuke Togami and Honoka Hashimoto won singles at WTT Star Contender Muscat as Japan swept four titles, while Hong Kong Finals fields locked for Kai Tak December 9–13 after the Oman points race ended

newsItems.title: Worlds Breaks Records
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 Opendoor Pickleball World Championships drew 70,000 fans and $2 million in ticket and registration revenue at Brookhaven Country Club, setting new PPA/MLP highs for attendance, viewership and social reach.

newsItems.title: Japan Sweeps Muscat
newsItems.excerpt: Shunsuke Togami and Honoka Hashimoto took WTT Star Contender Muscat singles crowns as Japan won four of five titles in Oman, with Togami and Satsuki Odo adding mixed doubles on finals day.

newsItems.title: Sinner Under The Knife
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 2 Jannik Sinner announced successful minor surgery on his iliotibial band on November 24 and will begin recovery after not competing since winning Wimbledon in July.

newsItems.title: Asal Rules Shanghai
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 Mostafa Asal beat Mohamad Zakaria in a four-game China Open final filled with video-ref drama to land his 31st PSA title as the Gold event wrapped in Shanghai.
